entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • 11.0 API Reviews #37993
    11.0.0
  • Global Query Filter: ChangeTracker deletes archived entity upon replacement instead of treating it as detached #37992
  • SQL Server provider: JSON_VALUE should emit RETURNING nvarchar(4000) instead of RETURNING nvarchar(max) to avoid Azure SQL engine crash #37991
  • Json field with value converter when converter converts nulls isn't converted #37983
  • ComplexCollection + SplitToTable → InvalidOperationException: Sequence contains more than one element #37982
  • Compiled model's CreateRelationalModel() fails when model contains owned entity #37981
  • Owned json collection remove add new and readd old throws InvalidOperationException #37980
  • Add a context option to allow reusing the same service provider (disabling caching) #37979
    Backlog

Closed

  • Regression: ExecuteUpdate fails for constant/literals assigned to for nullable int properties #37974
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37986
  • Fix run value converters that convert nulls for JSON columns #37984
    community-contribution
  • Fix memory leak in LazyLoaderFactory #37977
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Fix comparison to null for split entities #37987
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.6
  • Skip branch-PR validation in validate-pr-target-branch workflow #37988
  • [release/10.0] Port servicing-pr skill from main #37990
  • Copy over community-contribution label from closing PR to issue #37989
  • [release/10.0] Fix for persisting null optional complex property with default values #37952
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.6
  • Infer version from tags/branches instead of Versions.props #37985
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37978
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37976
  • Fix SetProperty discard lambda failing for nullable value type properties in ExecuteUpdate #37975

Updated

  • Show a warning when the tools are used with a platform-specific app #37868
  • Add support for BigInteger, Int128, and UInt128 in SqliteValueBinder #37492
    community-contribution
  • Fix ComplexCollection ToJson migration default value: use "[]" instead of "{}" #37965
  • Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 7.0.0 #37949
    breaking-change, community-contribution
